environment.note: maxRssKb measures the Node process. Chromium child-process memory is not included. Results are comparative local evidence, not production capacity guarantees.

candidates.name: svg-sharp
candidates.reason: Typography and line layout depend on the underlying SVG/font renderer and would require custom layout logic.

candidates.name: satori-sharp
candidates.reason: Controlled declarative layout, font bytes embedded in generated SVG, low local cost, no browser runtime, and existing Sharp reuse.

candidates.name: browser
candidates.reason: Higher latency and artifact size plus Chromium runtime, sandbox, shared-memory and operating-system dependency costs.

decision: Use pinned Satori plus pinned Sharp for the first static renderer increment. Keep Chromium outside the production renderer image.
